newsitem.title: USA: BOK Financial, First Texas Bank to merge.
newsitem.headline: BOK Financial, First Texas Bank to merge.

text.p: BOK Financial Corp said it and the parent company of First Texas Bank in Dallas reached a definitive agreement to merge in a cash transaction.
The merger is subject to approval of the definitive agreement by the board of directors and shareholders of First TexCorp Inc and receipt of regulatory approval.
First TexCorp has $135 million in assets and operates two offices.
BOK president Stanley Lybarger said the merger represents another step toward establishing a major presence for the company in Texas.
It is the company's second such agreement with a Dallas bank announced in the last three months. On October 3, BOK and First National Bank of Park Cities signed a definitive agreement to merge.
BOK Financial is a two-bank holding company with $4.4 billion in assets.
